capabilities: Restore a paragraph or whole note
extras: Desktop only (runs git); no network, account, or telemetry. Lab tools (review inbox, provenance lens, knowledge-graph playback, historical sandboxes, etc.) are off by default. Community scorecard lists two warnings, shell execution and filesystem access, neither touching the network. History reads are bounded (100 commits per note by default).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a note's Git version history, compare revisions, or restore earlier content.

relations.evidence: install the Obsidian Git community plugin and follow its setup

summary: Git-backed note history browser that compares any two versions and restores a paragraph or whole note with undo, reading Git only.
